prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE brand-new complete portrait colour manga page, preferably 1024 x 1536 native pixels, a 2:3 portrait. This is an original child-friendly mermaid comic for reading aloud. Crisp expressive manga ink, variable contour line weight, clean cel colour with subtle painted light, energetic gestures and clear emotions, occasional speed lines and small screentone shadows. Vary panel proportions and diagonals to serve the action. Very narrow straight manga gutters and thin black panel rules. Art fills the page; NO huge rounded cards, generic white caption bands, empty panels, copy-pasted figures, photographic collage, zoom-crop panels or duplicated drawings. Draw every panel as a distinct new instant with its own acting and composition. English left-to-right, top-to-bottom.
REFERENCE ROLES: the supplied cast sheet controls character appearance ONLY, city/pool controls setting ONLY, imp sources control imp identity ONLY. Do not copy any reference scene pixels, camera layout or character pose. All delivery artwork must be newly drawn for this page. Maintain this original book's characters, rather than any film characters.
IDENTITIES: Roshan is the smallest young mermaid, brown eyes and long brown waves with a rainbow forelock, coral/cream ornate pop-star jacket, narrow blue/gold fabric waist ribbons, exactly ONE continuous iridescent rainbow tail and a rainbow fanfin. No ribbon that reads as another tail. Rumi taller, thick lavender braid, purple/navy/gold performance jacket and cyan-to-lavender single tail with pink fanfin. Hana tallest, loose copper waves half-up twisted crown/celadon shell clip, coral long-sleeve jacket/cream high-neck blouse, celadon/teal single tail. Nari shorter/younger than Rumi, navy chin-length bob/crescent clip, mint hooded jacket/peach collar, lavender single tail/peach fanfin. Duri is a lavender courier turtle, rigid mint floral shell, exactly four lavender flippers, small shoulder courier bag and shell invitation bell. Imps have purple skin, pointed ears, small horns, bare purple hands, trousers and shoes: performer purple glitter jacket/mint shirt; magician navy coat/cape, top hat/red bow/star wand. No invented white gloves. No weapons or injury.
WORLD: every scene is UNDER Rumi's swimming pool INSIDE Pearl Castle. Already-magical water; no new portal, voice power or castle exterior journey. Korean-inspired underwater hanok lanes, dense pictogram shop fronts, tram on pearl bridge, tiled mint/cream bathhouse, coral/cream lounge and shell concert stage. Cyan, lavender, indigo, warm coral, pearl gold and restrained neon accents. Rich but quiet context around faces and action. No copied film shots, costumes, logos, characters or lyrics.
LETTERING: Render ONLY the exact quoted text supplied below, with the punctuation and word order unchanged. Speaker names are attribution instructions, not text to print (except title/subtitle). Use distinct readable speech balloons with short tails pointing to the correct speaker and small cream narrator caption shapes. Tail direction must make multi-speaker conversations unambiguous. Use large clear English print, high contrast, never over eyes/hands/contact/tails. No invented letters, background writing or decorative nonsense. Shop signs use pictures only. Preserve natural read order within each panel. Do not add page headings, panel labels or page numbers. Original song lettering can include tiny music notes.

BOOK PAGE 19. Story purpose (do not letter): She sets a clear boundary; her allies repeat her request without replacing her voice.
Exactly 3 sequential newly drawn manga panels. Use dynamic panel sizes suited to these beats, not a repeated strip template.

PANEL 1 art: Stage approach outside lounge. Roshan floats level with imp, still small but fully visible, friends just behind.
Exact lettering in reading order:
Roshan: "I am speaking. Please listen. This is everyone's song. My friends have something to sing. And I do too."

PANEL 2 art: Performer gathers long glitter curtain over stage entrance, acting anxious beneath showy grin.
Exact lettering in reading order:
Performer: "If we stop, they might forget us!"

PANEL 3 art: Rumi speaks beside Roshan; Hana and towel-free Nari also hold position. They back her rather than dragging her away.
Exact lettering in reading order:
Rumi: "Roshan has a turn too."
Nari: "We can all fit in one song."
modifications: none; byte-identical copy; no crop, resize, overlay or JPEG conversion
